item: Item 9a (written after reading a4/answers.md): Q4b sentence 'a fuel or redox change opens channels ... could only offset a loss if the loss were itself a KATP-type deficit; WT KATP is mostly closed'
depth: own reading of Karagiannis 2021 and abstracts; no Wwox datum seen
note: (1) A fuel change does not generally open channels: lactate and pyruvate close KATP and raise firing in neocortical neurons (34766906); BHB opens KATP in 2011 dentate granule cells, but later work finds GIRK (2026, dentate), A-type (2026, CA1 pyramidal) and KCNQ2/3 (recombinant, EC50 0.7 uM) mechanisms. (2) Added K+ conductance can offset a lost K+ conductance at the level of resting Rin and Vm whatever the channel; 'only if KATP-type' is not a valid constraint (the channel-specific function would not be restored). (3) 'WT KATP mostly closed' is the authors' inference for juvenile dentate granule cells; in neocortical neurons diazoxide roughly doubles whole-cell conductance. The sentence must be re-written as an open question with INFERENZA label.
